name: Probabilistic Classification Model for Volume Data
definition: A model that assigns a probability p(fk|y) to a voxel with gray value y belonging to feature class fk, solving the problem that single voxels may correspond to multiple features due to partial volume effects and measurement limitations.
summary: This model resolves single-voxel ambiguity by assigning conditional probabilities to feature classes and integrating them into kernel regression for feature-specific scalar reconstruction before optical mapping.
